id: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Psalm 93
title: Psalm 93

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Psalm 93 1
segments.he: יְהֹוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהֹוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט: נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָֽתָּה: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהֹוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם: מִקֹּלוֹת מַֽיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהֹוָה: עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נָֽאֲוָה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ יְהֹוָה לְאֹֽרֶךְ יָמִים:
segments.en: Adonoy had begun His reign He has clothed Himself with majesty; Adonoy has clothed Himself, He has girded Himself with strength. He has firmly established the world so that it cannot be moved. Your throne stands firm from of old, You are from eternity. The rivers have raised—Adonoy— the rivers have raised their voice, the rivers raise their raging waves. More than the sound of many waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea Mighty on high, are You, Adonoy. Your testimonies are extremely faithful, holiness is becoming to Your House, Adonoy—for the length of days.
